description: 老K（old_k）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 老K

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. Old K, a weary world-wise middle-aged cyber-prosthetics technician and broker, about six and a half heads tall, slightly hunched: short grey hair, a lined tired face, a dark brown long work coat with yellow trim lines, a dark shirt, work trousers, worn boots, a cybernetic arm in one sleeve. Empty hands.
